svg.aria-label: nosql-for-data-engineers: A hands-on NoSQL guide for data engineers who know SQL: five databases in Docker, with checked exercises. 6 / 6: source-to-lake reconciliations pass in the capstone. Single-node databases on one Mac. No cloud services.
